opening_strategy: Announce a new framework or tool release.
information_order: Introduce the tool and its purpose.
Explain the benefits and use cases.
evidence_style: Describe the tool's functionality and the problems it solves.
useful_details_to_include_when_in_brief: The core components or technologies it integrates.
The main advantages it offers over existing solutions.
common_weaknesses: Problems with processing long text inputs.
Lack of robustness in handling errors.
